questions_before_times: The kind of event: a birthday, a company party, a wedding, a shop visit or a small private party
The date, and the start and end time
The venue's name and town (for the travel fee), and indoors, outdoors or both
About how many guests, and the ages of the children (it sets the characters and the games)
Add-ons: a caricature table, a henna table, a second character, an extra hour
At the studio: henna or a caricature, and the design or the photo
safety_stop: Someone hurt, a fire, or a fight at the venue right now
A guest who has a bad skin reaction, or trouble breathing, after henna
license: None for character, caricature or henna work in most places. A local business license where the city or county asks for one: from the state form.

messages_never: Gate codes, access notes, a child's name, age and details, family notes, and any skin or medical note for henna stay on the secure page. The design form stays on its form. Texts to the characters carry none of them either.
